# claude-multi-desktop

> Free, open-source bash script (MIT) that runs two or more Claude Desktop accounts at the same time on one Mac. Each window has its own sign-in and chats; all windows share one Claude Code setup (~/.claude), so skills, CLAUDE.md, memory and MCP servers are the same in every account, and Claude Code sessions in different accounts can find and message each other with ListAgents and SendMessage. It never copies, patches or re-signs Claude.app; launchers use Electron's public --user-data-dir flag. Not affiliated with Anthropic. For legitimate use only, with accounts the user is entitled to use; not for getting around usage limits or sharing accounts.

## Install

Version 0.1.1. Every method needs macOS and Claude Desktop in /Applications.

- Homebrew: `brew install jackson-cmd/tap/claude-multi-desktop`
- Mac installer: `claude-multi-desktop-0.1.1.pkg` from https://github.com/jackson-cmd/claude-multi-desktop/releases/latest. It installs the command to /usr/local/bin and the double-click app "Claude Multi Desktop" to /Applications. It is not signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks the first open (macOS 15 and later: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway; macOS 14 and earlier: right-click the file > Open).
- Disk image: `claude-multi-desktop-0.1.1.dmg` from the same release page. Drag "Claude Multi Desktop" to Applications and double-click it; it asks for an account name, an icon style and a colour, makes the launcher and opens it. No Terminal needed. Same Gatekeeper note as the installer.
- npm: `npx claude-multi-desktop add Work` or `npm install -g claude-multi-desktop`
- PyPI: `pipx install claude-multi-desktop` or `uvx claude-multi-desktop add Work`
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add jackson-cmd/claude-multi-desktop`, then `/plugin install account-handoff@multi-desktop`. Its skill `handoff` hands a task to a Claude Code session in another account with ListAgents, SendMessage and `claude-multi-desktop peers`, and refuses to move work because an account hit a usage limit. It does not install the command itself.
- curl or git clone: see the README at https://github.com/jackson-cmd/claude-multi-desktop

## Commands

`add NAME [--default] [--icon claude|/path/to/picture] [--color HEX]`, `icon NAME --icon ... --color HEX`, `rename NAME NEW`, `list [--names]`, `open NAME`, `peers`, `remove NAME [--delete-data]`. With `--icon claude` the icon is drawn on the user's Mac from their own Claude.app with a coloured letter badge; nothing from Anthropic is shipped. Once a window is open, the Dock shows the normal Claude icon and name, because Claude.app decides that and the tool never modifies Claude.app.

## Docs

- [Home](https://jackson-cmd.github.io/claude-multi-desktop/): what it does, quick start, every install method, icons and names, commands, FAQ
- [Two Claude accounts on a Mac](https://jackson-cmd.github.io/claude-multi-desktop/guides/two-claude-accounts-on-mac.html): step-by-step setup
- [Sessions across accounts](https://jackson-cmd.github.io/claude-multi-desktop/guides/claude-code-sessions-across-accounts.html): let Claude Code sessions in different accounts message each other, with or without the Claude Code plugin
- [Source and README](https://github.com/jackson-cmd/claude-multi-desktop)
